extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners and patent practitioners (applicants/attorneys)
extracted.subtask_description: Form-paragraph and procedural guidance for preparing USPTO office actions, examiner answers, appeal-related communications, reissue applications, examiner amendments, fee and timing requirements, and related correspondence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition or Request Dismissed - Proper Fee Not Submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant’s petition or request under 37 CFR [1] filed [2] is DISMISSED because the proper petition or processing fee of [3] required under 37 CFR 1.17 has not been submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner Note lists specific petition/request types requiring fees: (1) 37 CFR 1.48 correcting inventorship requires fee per 1.17(i); (2) petitions to suspend action under 1.103(a) require fee per 1.17(a) or as set forth; (3) petitions to withdraw application from issue under 1.313 require fee per 1.17(h); (4) petitions for extension of time under 1.136(a) require varying fees per 1.17(a)(1)-(5); (5) requests to suspend action under 1.103(b) or (c) require fee per 1.17(i); (6) requests to defer examination under 1.103(d) require fee per 1.17(i) and publication fee per 1.18(d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition Header Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Required header format for petition correspondence: 'In re Application of: [1] : Appl. No.: [2] : DECISION ON PETITION Filed: [3] : [5] For: [4] :'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this standardized header in petition decisions to ensure necessary identifying information is present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal Dismissed - Allowed Claims, Formal Matters Remaining
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicant fails to file a brief within the time prescribed by 37 CFR 41.37(a), the appeal stands dismissed and proceedings as to the rejected claims are considered terminated; application will be passed to issue on allowed claim [1] provided the listed formal matters are corrected within a shortened TWO MONTH statutory period to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when notice of appeal filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Note: form paragraph should only be used if formal matters cannot be handled by examiner’s amendment (MPEP § 1215.04). Extensions of time may be granted under 37 CFR 1.136. Insert description of formal matters in bracket 2 and identify allowed claims per bracket guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension To File Brief - Granted
rubrics_metrics.description: The request for an extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(b) for filing the appeal brief under 37 CFR 41.37 filed on [1] has been approved for [2].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For use if the notice of appeal was filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Insert amount of time approved. Use only when 37 CFR 1.136(a) not available or exhausted (e.g., litigation reissues or when appellant requests to reopen prosecution or file a reply brief per 41.39(b) and 41.50(a)(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension To File Brief - Denied
rubrics_metrics.description: The request for an extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(b) for filing the appeal brief under 37 CFR 41.37 filed on [1] has been disapproved because no sufficient cause for the extension has been shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For use if notice of appeal filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Use only when 1.136(a) not available or exhausted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reopening of Prosecution After Appeal Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: In view of the [1] filed on [2], PROSECUTION IS HEREBY REOPENED. [3] set forth below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To avoid abandonment appellant must either (1) file a reply under 37 CFR 1.111 (if the Office action is non-final) or 37 CFR 1.113 (if final); or (2) initiate a new appeal by filing a notice of appeal under 37 CFR 41.31 followed by an appeal brief under 37 CFR 41.37. Previously paid fees may be applied but increases must be paid. A Supervisory Patent Examiner (SPE) must approve reopening by signature. Use when appeal brief (or amended appeal brief) is filed; insert reasons/new grounds in brackets as directed. New grounds may make subsequent Office action final under specified conditions (MPEP §706.07(a)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner’s Answer Cover Sheet (PTAB)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cover sheet template for Examiner’s Answer before the Patent Trial and Appeal Board including Application Number, Filing Date, Appellant(s), and identification of the Examiner’s Answer in response to the appeal brief.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For use if notice of appeal filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Insert specific application, filing date, appellant name(s), registered representative, and date brief filed into designated brackets. Printed with USPTO letterhead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounds of Rejection to be Reviewed on Appeal (Heading)
rubrics_metrics.description: Heading indicating the grounds of rejection that will be reviewed on appeal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For use if notice of appeal filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Follow this form paragraph with 12.254.01 or 12.254.02 as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Grounds of Rejection, Not Modified
rubrics_metrics.description: Every ground of rejection set forth in the Office action dated [1] from which the appeal is taken is being maintained by the examiner except for the grounds of rejection (if any) listed under 'WITHDRAWN REJECTIONS.' New grounds of rejection (if any) are provided under 'NEW GROUNDS OF REJECTION.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when there was no modification made to the grounds in an advisory action or pre-appeal conference decision. Insert mailing date of the Office action in bracket 1. Use form paragraphs 12.255/12.256/12.257 as needed to restate, introduce, or withdraw grounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of Grounds of Rejection, Modified
rubrics_metrics.description: The ground(s) of rejection set forth in the Office action dated [1] have been modified by the [2] dated [3]. Withdrawn and new grounds are to be listed under the respective subheadings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert mailing date of original Office action, specify advisory action and/or pre-appeal brief conference decision, and include dates. Use when grounds were modified in an advisory action or pre-appeal decision; follow with 12.255/12.256/12.257 as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restatement of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a concise statement of each new ground of rejection presented for review in bracket 1; conclude an examiner’s answer raising new grounds with form paragraph 12.279.01 to notify applicant of the reply period and options.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When introducing new grounds in an examiner's answer, restate each new ground concisely and conclude with required notification of reply period and TC Director approval requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawn Rejections
rubrics_metrics.description: List of grounds of rejection that are not presented for review on appeal because they have been withdrawn by the examiner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the notice of appeal was filed on or after Jan 23, 2012. Insert withdrawn grounds into bracket 1. Use form paragraph 12.257 to indicate withdrawn rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response to Argument
rubrics_metrics.description: State the ground(s) of rejection applicable to the appealed claims and provide explanations as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precede with either 12.254.01 or 12.254.02. Optionally include a statement/reasoning for every ground of rejection involved in the appeal. Only use when the restatement of the rejection does not include any new ground(s). If an issue raised by appellant was fully responded to under 'Grounds of Rejection to be Reviewed on Appeal' no additional response is required; otherwise provide a full response after this paragraph. Use for appeals filed on or after Jan 23, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion to Examiner’s Answer, No New Grounds of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: For the above reasons, it is believed that the rejections should be sustained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to conclude an examiner's answer when no new grounds of rejection are raised.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Grounds of Rejection - Heading and Identification
rubrics_metrics.description: NEW GROUNDS OF REJECTION must be prominently identified in the examiner’s answer (e.g., by using this form paragraph).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any new ground(s) of rejection in the examiner’s answer must be prominently identified. A Technology Center Director or designee must personally approve the new ground(s) by signing. Also remind applicant of the requirement to pay any appeal forwarding fee under 37 CFR 41.45 within the permitted time unless earlier applicable fees were timely paid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conclusion to Examiner’s Answer Raising New Grounds of Rejection (Reply Options and Time Limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appellant must within TWO MONTHS from the date of the examiner’s answer exercise one of the two options to avoid sua sponte dismissal of the appeal as to the claims subject to the new ground: (1) reopen prosecution by filing a reply under 37 CFR 1.111 with or without amendment, affidavit or other evidence relevant to the new grounds; or (2) maintain appeal by filing a reply brief under 37 CFR 41.41 addressing each new ground as set forth in 37 CFR 41.37(c)(1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any amendment/affidavit/evidence submitted with a reply brief will be treated as a request to reopen prosecution per 41.39(b)(1). Extensions under 37 CFR 1.136(a) are not applicable to the TWO MONTH period; see 1.136(b) and 1.550(c) for other extension procedures. New grounds require TC Director approval. Use 12.279.01 to notify applicant and include required approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dismissal Following New Ground(s) of Rejection in Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: If appellant failed to timely respond to the examiner’s answer that included a new ground of rejection, the appeal as to the claims subject to the new ground is dismissed and those claims are canceled; only remaining claims (if any) continue and the application will be forwarded to the Board.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under 37 CFR 41.39(b), appellant must file either a reply under 1.111 or a reply brief under 41.41 within two months. Insert mailing date and claim numbers as directed in brackets. For appeals filed on or after Jan 23, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request to Present Oral Arguments (Examiner)
rubrics_metrics.description: The examiner requests the opportunity to present arguments at the oral hearing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only if an oral hearing has been requested by appellant and the primary examiner intends to present an oral argument. This form paragraph must be included as a separate letter on form PTOL-90.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute Examiner’s Answer - On Remand for Further Consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to remand under 37 CFR 41.50(a)(1) by the PTAB for further consideration of a rejection, a substitute Examiner’s Answer under 37 CFR 41.50(a)(2) is set forth; appellant must within TWO MONTHS exercise one of two options (reopen prosecution via 1.111 or maintain appeal via 41.41) to avoid dismissal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert date of remand and provide reasons supporting the rejections in the substitute answer. A TC Director or designee must approve every substitute examiner’s answer. Any reply that includes amendment/affidavit/evidence will be treated as request to withdraw appeal per 41.50(a)(2). Extensions under 1.136(a) are not applicable to the TWO MONTH period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dismissal Following a Substitute Examiner’s Answer (Remand)
rubrics_metrics.description: If appellant failed to timely respond to the substitute examiner’s answer mailed on [1] written in response to a remand by the Board, the appeal as to claims [2] is dismissed and these claims are canceled; only claims [3] remain and the appeal continues as to those claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Under 37 CFR 41.50(a)(2) appellant must, within two months, file either a reply under 1.111 or a reply brief under 41.41 to avoid dismissal. Insert dates and claim numbers per Examiner Notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner Sustained in Part - Rewriting Dependent Claims (No Allowed Claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Board affirmed rejection(s) against independent claim(s) [1] but reversed all rejections against dependent claim(s) [2], and there are no allowed claims, the independent claim(s) is/are canceled and applicant is given a TWO MONTH period to present the dependent claim(s) in independent form to avoid abandonment; extensions under 37 CFR 1.136(a) are available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prosecution is otherwise closed. Insert mailing date and identify allowed/dependent claims as directed. Use when appeal filed on or after Jan 23, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner Sustained in Part - Rewriting Dependent Claims (At Least One Allowed Claim)
rubrics_metrics.description: When the Board affirmed rejections against independent claim(s) [1] but reversed rejections against dependent claim(s) [2], and at least one allowed claim exists, the independent claim(s) is/are canceled and applicant is given a ONE MONTH period to present dependent claims in independent form; NO EXTENSIONS under 37 CFR 1.136 will be granted; failure results in cancellation and application allowed with specified claim(s) [3].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert appropriate claim numbers. Prosecution is otherwise closed. Use for appeals filed on or after Jan 23, 2012; note the stricter one-month no-extension rule when at least one allowed claim remains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Period For Seeking Court Review Has Lapsed
rubrics_metrics.description: The period under 37 CFR 90.3 for seeking court review of the PTAB decision [1] has expired and no further action taken by appellant; proceedings as to the rejected claims are terminated and the application will be passed to issue on allowed claim [2] provided listed formal matters are promptly corrected; applicant must correct within a shortened TWO MONTH statutory period to avoid abandonment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert decision rendering date and identify formal matters to be corrected in bracket 3. Extensions under 1.136 may be granted. Prosecution otherwise closed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment After Board Decision, Entry Refused
rubrics_metrics.description: An amendment filed [1] after a decision by the PTAB is not entered because prosecution is closed; prosecution will not be reopened by the primary examiner after a final Board decision except under 37 CFR 1.114 (RCE) or 37 CFR 41.50 with written authority of the Director and only for matters not adjudicated and with sufficient cause shown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert date amendment was filed. Do not use where a 37 CFR 41.50(b) rejection has been made by the Board. Use for appeals filed on or after Jan 23, 2012.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement for Rewritten Specification
rubrics_metrics.description: Interlineations or cancellations made in the specification or amendments to the claims which could lead to confusion and mistake during issue and printing require that identified portions of the specification or claims be rewritten before passing the case to issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 37 CFR 1.125 and MPEP § 608.01(q). Specific discussion of sections required to be rewritten must be set forth. See form paragraph 6.28.01 for substitute specification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner’s Amendment (General)
rubrics_metrics.description: An examiner’s amendment to the record appears below. If the changes and/or additions are unacceptable to applicant, an amendment may be filed as provided by 37 CFR 1.312. To ensure consideration of such an amendment, it MUST be submitted no later than the payment of the issue fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This form paragraph is NOT to be used in a reexamination proceeding (use form paragraph 22.06 instead).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner’s Amendment Authorized - Reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: When an examiner’s amendment is authorized, provide a detailed statement of the reason(s) certain claim(s) have been indicated as being allowable or as containing allowable subject matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 provide detailed statement of reasons for allowing certain claims. Use with related examiner amendment form paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reopen Prosecution - After Notice of Allowance (Examiner’s Amendment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Authorization for an examiner's amendment given in an interview with [1] on [2] reopens prosecution on claim [1] considered unpatentable for reasons indicated below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert interview participant and date. Use when prosecution is reopened after Notice of Allowance and examiner’s amendment authorized in interview.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Time and Examiner’s Amendment Authorized
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(a) is required in order to make an examiner’s amendment which places this application in condition for allowance. During a conversation [1], [2] requested an extension for [3] MONTH(S) and authorized charging Deposit Account No. [4] the required fee of $[5] for this extension and authorized the examiner’s amendment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any amendment to be considered MUST be submitted no later than payment of the issue fee. See MPEP § 706.07(f) which explains when an extension is needed to make amendments placing the application in condition for allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for Allowance / Reasons for Indication of Allowable Subject Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance or for indication of allowable subject matter must be provided: 'The following is an examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance: [1]'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any comments by applicant must be submitted no later than payment of the issue fee and should be labeled 'Comments on Statement of Reasons for Allowance.' Do not use in reexamination proceedings (use form paragraph 22.16). For pre-allowance office actions use 13.03.01.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reopen Prosecution - Vacate Notice of Allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: If the Notice of Allowance mailed [1] is vacated, prosecution is reopened; if the issue fee has been paid applicant may request a refund or credit to a deposit account or wait until the application is allowable or held abandoned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upon receipt of a new Notice of Allowance applicant may request that the previously submitted issue fee be applied. If abandoned applicant may request refund or credit. Use this paragraph when prosecution is reopened after mailing of the Notice of Allowance; insert date of Notice of Allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Time by Examiner’s Amendment (Telephone Authorizations)
rubrics_metrics.description: An extension of time under 37 CFR 1.136(a) may be required to place the application in condition for allowance; during a telephone conversation [1], [2] requested an extension for [3] MONTH(S) and authorized charge to Deposit Account No. [4] for fee $[5].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See MPEP § 706.07(f), item J for when an extension is needed to make amendments to place the application in condition for allowance. When examiner’s amendment also authorized, use form paragraph 13.02.02 instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement Filed After Issue Fee Paid
rubrics_metrics.description: An information disclosure statement (IDS) filed after the issue fee has been paid will not be considered but will be placed in the file; the application may be withdrawn from issue to file an RCE upon grant of an appropriate petition (e.g., 1.313(c)(2)) or replaced with a continuing application upon grant of a petition under 1.313(c)(3), or treated under other provisions of 1.313.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this form paragraph with PTOL-90 or PTO-90C for IDS submitted after issue fee payment. Insert IDS filing date in bracket 1. Also note alternatives: petition to withdraw from issue under 1.313(c)(1) with unequivocal statement that one or more claims are unpatentable over IDS information will allow IDS to be considered upon withdrawal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Filed After Payment of Issue Fee, Not Entered
rubrics_metrics.description: An amendment filed on [1] after the issue fee was paid will not be entered because 37 CFR 1.312 no longer permits filing an amendment after the issue fee has been paid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this paragraph with form PTOL-90 or PTO-90C. Insert amendment date in bracket 1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissue Application - Applicable Laws and Rules Heading (Pre-AIA vs Post-AIA)
rubrics_metrics.description: For reissue applications filed before Sept 16, 2012, references to 35 U.S.C. 251 and 37 CFR 1.172, 1.175, and 3.73 refer to pre-AIA provisions. For reissue applications filed on or after Sept 16, 2012, references are to the current provisions. This paragraph must be used as a heading in all Office actions in reissue applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies which statutory/regulatory text applies depending on filing date. Use as heading in reissue Office actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective Reissue Oath/Declaration - No Statement of a Specific Error
rubrics_metrics.description: The reissue oath/declaration is defective because it fails to identify at least one error which is relied upon to support the reissue application. See 37 CFR 1.175 and MPEP § 1414.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the reissue oath/declaration does not contain any statement of an error relied upon. This includes forms that mention 'errors' generally but fail to identify a specific error. Form paragraph 14.14 must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective Reissue Oath/Declaration - Identified 'Error' Is Not Appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: The reissue oath/declaration is defective because the error which is relied upon to support the reissue application is not an error upon which a reissue can be based. See 37 CFR 1.175 and MPEP § 1414.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when the oath/declaration identifies only one error and that error is not an appropriate basis for reissue. Form paragraph 14.14 must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective Reissue Oath/Declaration - Multiple Identified 'Errors' Not Appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: The reissue oath/declaration is defective because none of the errors relied upon to support the reissue application are errors upon which a reissue can be based. See 37 CFR 1.175 and MPEP § 1414.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when more than one error is identified and none are appropriate for reissue. Note: if at least one identified error is appropriate, this paragraph should NOT be used. Form paragraph 14.14 must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Oath or Declaration Required Prior to Allowance - Pre-AIA (Lack of 'Without Any Deceptive Intention')
rubrics_metrics.description: For reissue applications filed before Sept 16, 2012, the reissue oath/declaration is defective if it fails to contain a statement that all errors corrected in the reissue application arose 'without any deceptive intention' on the part of the applicant, as required by pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.175 and MPEP § 1414.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for pre-AIA reissue applications lacking the required statement. A supplemental oath/declaration must be received before allowance. Provide example language to be used in supplemental oath/declaration and follow with form paragraph 14.14.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective Reissue Oath/Declaration - No Statement of Defect in the Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: The reissue oath/declaration is defective because it fails to contain the statements required under 37 CFR 1.175 as to applicant’s belief that the original patent is wholly or partly inoperative or invalid, or fails to state the reason (defective specification,drawing, or claiming more/less than patentee had the right to claim).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when applicant fails to allege that the original patent is inoperative or invalid and/or fails to state the reason of defect. In bracket 1 point out the specific defect using the language of the regulation. Form paragraph 14.14 must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Defective Reissue Oath/Declaration - General Use (Rejection Until Supplemental Oath Submitted)
rubrics_metrics.description: Remind applicant of requirement for submission of a supplemental reissue oath/declaration under pre-AIA 37 CFR 1.175(b)(1) before allowance and, at the same time, reject all claims since the reissue application is defective until the supplemental oath/declaration is submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In bracket 1 list all claims in the reissue application; bracket 2 insert either 'oath' or 'declaration'. Use to both remind and reject claims until compliance.
